check_distribution_strategy: check the current TensorFlow distribution strategy is compatible with Sonnet optimizers
check_updates_parameters: check that updates and parameters sequences have matching lengths and are non-empty
check_same_dtype: check that a parameter update and its corresponding variable share the same dtype
deduplicate_indexed_slices: deduplicate TensorFlow IndexedSlices by summing values for duplicate indices
test_optimizer_utils: test the optimizer utility functions for validation and indexed slice deduplication
